facts.fact: ARTCI gave Starlink Network CIV a 12-month provisional licence, announced by the Minister of Digital Transition on 11 June 2026, with terms to be reviewed at the end of the period.
SpaceX switched Starlink on in Cote d'Ivoire on 16 July 2026; the residential plan costs CFA 28,746 a month for up to 100 Mbps.
Orange sells satellite broadband in Cote d'Ivoire through a deal with Eutelsat, since January 2026.
MTN sells satellite broadband in Cote d'Ivoire through a deal with Eutelsat, since April 2026.
Starlink (sold directly to households) and Eutelsat Konnect (sold by Orange and MTN) are both on sale in Cote d'Ivoire as of the 28 July 2026 article.

systems.owner: Eutelsat; resold by Orange and MTN
